title: ExtractionField
description: One value read from a document version by an extraction provider, version 0.1.0. No TMF667 counterpart (extension). Confidence is stored for audit (the provider does not keep it for us). The UI shows confidence as a band with text, never colour alone.

versionId.description: Extraction belongs to a version, never to the document.

band.description: Derived from the tenant thresholds; default high >= 0.90, medium 0.70-0.89, low < 0.70.

source.description: Where in the file the value was read. Lets the UI highlight the passage.

box.description: Fractions of page width and height, 0 to 1.

spotCheck.description: Kept for human review although High, to measure calibration. Set in data, never at random in the prototype.

originalValue.x-note: value is what the person set; originalValue is what the provider read.
